summary.text: Sword Heart Clarity is an immortal killer move in Sword Saint true inheritance. It is used to restrict wisdom path and other similar methods, and few Sword Childs in history could use it.

claims.text: Above Blood Plain, Nian Er Yi Fang rushes out of Golden Dawn Hall as if to save Nian Er Ping Zhi. Hao Zhen shoots lightning at his face, and Yi Fang blocks with wooden armor instead of reaching the fight. Chu Du realizes this means the rescue is not urgent.

Granny Yin has already surrounded Nian Er Ping Zhi with vengeful ghosts and activated bewitching soul art. His eyes lost their light, the sword light dissipated into his true body, and he floats as if his mind has halted. The sluggish looking Nian Er Ping Zhi suddenly lets out extremely sharp, mysterious light from his eyes. Granny Yin’s mind sends warnings of danger, but it is already late. A stunning sword light cuts her into two. Bewitching soul art, her proudest method, was ineffective against him. Nian Er Yi Fang names this immortal killer move as the restriction. Chu Du separately judges the killing strike as one sword life, an immortal killer move Sword Saint Nian Er used in his younger days.
Gong Wan Ting sends Nian Er Ping Zhi. He uses this immortal killer move and kills Granny Yin, whom narration calls a renowned demonic path expert.
